senses.gloss: ch. (v. אִיסוּרָא) chain; prison. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 end לבושי יִיסּוּרֵיה his prison clothes; (Targ. Jer. LII, 33 איסוריה).—Pl. יִסּוּרִין, יִיסּ׳, יִיסּוּרֵי, יְסוּ׳.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 3:6">Targ. Lam. III, 6</cite>.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 28:22">Targ. Is. XXVIII, 22</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="J00460"><he>יְסיּ׳</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 30:14">Targ. Jer. XXX, 14</cite>.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 30:11">Ib. 11</cite> (v. <cite ref="A01408"><he>אִיסוּרָא</he> II</cite>).

<cite ref="Berakhot 60a">Ber. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>י׳ בעי וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>יסורים</he> h. form) that man desires to bring suffering upon himself.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:1">B. Mets. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>קביל עליה י׳</he> he submitted patiently to sufferings.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 85a:3">Ib. 85ᵃ</cite>; a. fr. Lam. R. introd. end <he>למימר לית יִיסּוּרַיָּא חשיבין וכ׳</he> as if saying, sufferings count to me for nothing.
